goal: Establish the fixed architecture inventory, counterexample-tested gates and fail-closed delivery eligibility before business refactoring.
invariants: No changes to legacy backend, framework gitlink/source, generated business artifacts or runtime behavior.
No governance weakening and business change in the same task.
Frozen debt is visible and cannot grow in place.
Independent review and live exact-head evidence are mandatory; unprotected main cannot be called hard-enforced.
counterexamples: Unclassified package, flat application SQL, inactive/generated source import and renamed raw write receiver must be rejected.
Stale base, unplanned path, contributor approval, dismissed review, skipped job and old workflow attempt must be rejected.
The same committed source must yield byte-identical architecture reports.
next: ARCH-02 (after ARCH-01 independent approval and integration; no business code moved in ARCH-01)
